hint1: They can fly, and will crush you!
hint2: Three arrive together, and a single splash hit clears all three.
hint3: Small, blue, and permanently airborne.
description: A small flying group shows up and starts causing problems.

hint1: They'll help you take down ground and air units, but you're on your own with hair coloring advice.
hint2: A pair who loose arrows one at a time from a comfortable distance - no splash, just steady chip damage.
hint3: Two women in green hoods with longbows.
description: Two ranged helpers who try their best from a safe distance.

hint1: The Barbarian's handsome, cultured cousin.
hint2: Swings a short sword at one target at a time, and soaks up far more punishment than he deals out.
hint3: Armoured head to toe in blue-grey plate, with a neat beard and a small round shield.
description: A dude who walks forward and soaks up trouble.

hint1: Who the heck taught these guys to throw spears?!
hint2: Three of them hurl javelins from a distance, one target at a time.
hint3: Green, scrawny and grinning, each armed with a pointed stick taller than it is.
description: A pack of quick pests that poke at things from range.

hint1: Small, fast, green and mean!
hint2: Four of them rush in and stab at close range - individually harmless, collectively a problem.
hint3: Knife-wielding, sharp-eared, and famously interested in other people’s gold.
description: Fast little attackers that appear, stab, and disappear

hint1: Small, lightly protected skeleton who throws bombs.
hint2: Lobs explosives that burst on impact, damaging everything clustered around the landing spot.
hint3: A small figure in a tattered blue cap, hauling a sack nearly as big as he is.
description: A fragile troublemaker who throws something that goes boom.

hint1: Surround your enemies with this pile of bones!
hint2: Three of them swarm whatever is closest and scratch at it - good for a distraction, little else.
hint3: Three of them, each carrying a small sword. Cheap enough to throw away.
description: Tiny distractions meant to annoy, delay, and get in the way.

hint1: A horde of melee attackers with mean mustaches and even meaner tempers.
hint2: Four of them swing heavy axes, one target apiece - together they dismantle almost anything they can reach.
hint3: Shirtless, kilted and blond, each carrying a broad axe.
description: A loud group that runs in and starts swinging

hint1: Locked in an eternal battle with Knight for the best mustache.
hint2: Sacrifices itself to send a bolt arcing between up to nine nearby targets.
hint3: A small crackling ball of blue lightning, grinning.
description: A tiny spark that jumps in and causes a quick mess.

hint1: They also play a mean rib cage xylophone duet.
hint2: A pair of fliers whose breath splashes across a small area rather than hitting one target.
hint3: Two winged creatures of bare ribs and hollow sockets, with no flesh to speak of.
description: A flying pair that makes clustered areas uncomfortable.

hint1: It'd be adorable if it wasn't on fire.
hint2: Charges in and detonates on contact, scorching everything in a small radius.
hint3: A tiny grinning ball of flame with stubby little arms.
description: A small fiery thing that rushes in and vanishes fast.

hint1: Think of them as sweet, purple... balls of DESTRUCTION!
hint2: Five of them flit in and bite one target each - fragile enough that any splash clears the lot.
hint3: Five small purple fliers with oversized ears and tiny fangs.
description: A fast swarm that overwhelms lonely targets.

hint1: They dream of ponies and one day wearing metal buckets.
hint2: Six deploy in a line spanning the whole arena, each behind a shield that absorbs one hit.
hint3: Six young soldiers in blue tabards, each with a spear and a wooden shield.
description: A spread-out squad that tries to hold the line

hint1: Destroying enemy buildings with his massive cannon is his job; making a raggedy blond beard look good is his passion.
hint2: Fires cannonballs from well outside tower range, strolling past everything else to do it.
hint3: A vast bearded man in a red singlet, hauling an artillery piece under one arm.
description: A big guy who prefers to target important structures.

hint1: Stay frosty.
hint2: Hops onto a target and bursts, briefly locking everything nearby in place.
hint3: A tiny pale-blue ball with a cheeky grin.
description: A tiny blue thing that buys you a brief moment.

hint1: It's surprising how often she needs her axes sharpened.
hint2: Swings faster the longer she is left alone, and shrugs off spell damage that would finish others.
hint3: Twin axes, war paint, and no armour to speak of.
description: A quick fighter who never seems to slow down

hint1: It's a Skeleton party in the sky.
hint2: Floats overhead toward the nearest building, then bursts and drops a squad of bones below.
hint3: A wooden keg slung beneath a bunch of balloons, rattling as it drifts.
description: A floating surprise that turns into extra problems.

hint1: It's like a Goblin Value Pack!
hint2: Six arrive at once - the front rank stabs at close range while the back rank throws from a distance.
hint3: Green and sharp-eared, some clutching knives, others carrying spears.
description: A mixed group of pests that covers multiple situations.

hint1: Spawns a pair of leveled up Barbarians.
hint2: Two of them, charging in far quicker than their size suggests and hitting hard enough to erase most single targets.
hint3: A pair of hulking blond warriors with braided beards and war paint.
description: Two fast bruisers who arrive earlier than you wanted.

hint1: Three's a crowd, six is a horde!
hint2: Six fliers arrive at once, each stabbing a single target - devastating together, erased by any splash.
hint3: Six small blue creatures with bat wings and a single horn.
description: A lot of flying trouble all at once.

hint1: This is what happens when Archers get bored!
hint2: Launches a rocket that bursts into sparks behind the target, and recoils backwards with every shot.
hint3: A woman in a bandana with a launch tube held at her side.
description: A chaotic ranged attacker who never stands still.

hint1: Slingshots full of Double Trouble Gum!
hint2: Three together - a large boy shielding the front while two girls attack from behind him.
hint3: Three kids in blue caps: one big lad, two smaller girls behind.
description: A small crew: one up front, others behind.

hint1: A medium-sized shaft, red fletchings.
hint2: A wide volley rains over a large area, clearing anything fragile caught underneath.
hint3: A dark flight of shafts falling point-first across a broad circle.
description: A simple answer to ‘too many small things.'

hint1: Briefly stunning them and dealing damage inside a small radius.
hint2: A brief jolt over a small area that stuns and resets whatever enemies were doing.
hint3: A quick violet flash, gone almost before you see it.
description: A quick burst that interrupts whatever was happening.

hint1: Once it began rolling down Frozen Peak, there was no stopping it.
hint2: Knocks light troops backwards and slows whatever it hits for a few seconds.
hint3: A packed sphere of ice.
description: A big shove that also slows things down.

hint1: No need to sign for this package!
hint2: A crate drops from the sky after a short delay, damaging the area and releasing a soldier.
hint3: A wooden crate on a parachute, with a guard climbing out.
description: A delayed surprise that hits an area and leaves help.

hint1: Shoots cannonballs with deadly effect.
hint2: A ground-only emplacement firing steady single shots until its short lifetime runs out.
hint3: A squat iron tube on a wooden mount, aimed low.
description: A basic defensive tool that focuses on ground threats.

hint1: Shoots big boulders that deal area damage.
hint2: Lobs shells clear over the river at the enemy tower, but ignores anything that walks right up to it.
hint3: A stubby wide-mouthed barrel angled at the sky.
description: A long-range annoyance that doesn’t like close company.

hint1: The power of Electrickery is best kept grounded.
hint2: Stays buried until something comes near, then surfaces and zaps it - untouchable while hidden.
hint3: A coil on a retractable platform, crackling when it rises.
description: A defensive surprise that appears when it’s needed.

hint1: The Arena is a certified butterfly-free zone.
hint2: Hits harder in a single swing than almost anything else, but folds to a swarm.
hint3: A compact suit of dark armour with an enormous sword.
description: A small fighter with big damage energy.

hint1: Don't be fooled by her delicately coiffed hair.
hint2: Fires single shots from long range - reliable against almost anything, but slow to reload.
hint3: A woman in a wide-brimmed hat holding a long-barrelled gun with a flared mouth.
description: A steady shooter who handles problems one at a time.

hint1: A real one-man wrecking crew!
hint2: Absorbs enormous punishment and never once stops to fight back at what is hitting him.
hint3: A huge bald man in a brown tunic with a broad belt and bare feet.
description: A slow tank that ignores distractions.

hint1: She can take them all out with a few spins.
hint2: Spins a full circle with her axe, striking everything around her at once.
hint3: A red-haired warrior with a heavy double-headed axe.
description: A tough brawler who clears space around herself.

hint1: Flying, armored and powerful. What could be its weakness?! Cupcakes.
hint2: Strikes slowly but heavily, and shrugs off spell damage that would clear lighter fliers.
hint3: An armoured grey gargoyle with a horned helm and a spiked tail.
description: A durable flying attacker with a serious hit.

hint1: Two troops holding a big log charge at the nearest building.
hint2: Builds speed as it runs, and the pair carrying it keep fighting after it shatters.
hint3: Two bearded soldiers hauling a huge banded log between them.
description: A fast push tool that wants to reach something important.

hint1: The most awesome man to ever set foot in the Arena.
hint2: Hurls bursts of flame that scorch everything clustered around the point of impact.
hint3: A bearded man in a purple robe with rolled-up sleeves.
description: A flashy ranged attacker who likes groups.

hint1: The Master Builder has sent his first contraption to the Arena!
hint2: Out-ranges nearly everything it faces, plinking away from a safe distance.
hint3: A goggled pilot in a rickety wooden contraption with a spinning rotor.
description: A fragile flyer that pokes from farther than expected.

hint1: Fast melee troop that targets buildings and can jump over the river.
hint2: Vaults clean over the river in a single bound, which is how he reaches a tower before defenders gather.
hint3: A grinning man with a mohawk riding a large boar bareback.
description: A fast guy who heads straight for the objective

hint1: The King’s personal pets are loose! They love to chomp on apples and towers alike.
hint2: Four vault the river together and spread out, which makes them awkward to clear with one spell.
hint3: Four pink porkers in tiny crowns, snouts down and charging.
description: Multiple fast attackers that split your attention.

hint1: Disrespecting them would not be just a mistake, it would be a cardinal sin!
hint2: A trio of long-range shooters who can be split across both lanes on deployment.
hint3: A trio in matching plumed hats, each with a long-barrelled firearm.
description: A pricey commitment that demands you protect it.

hint1: With each attack, she unleashes a powerful healing aura that restores Hitpoints to herself and friendly Troops.
hint2: Attacking triggers a pulse that restores hitpoints to her and anything friendly nearby.
hint3: Winged and armoured, carrying a staff rather than a blade.
description: A fighter who keeps herself (and nearby friends) going.

hint1: He's tough, targets buildings and explodes when destroyed, slowing nearby enemies.
hint2: Bursts on death, chilling everything nearby and finishing off anything already weakened.
hint3: A squat, lumbering figure built from pale blue crystal.
description: A cheap tank that leaves a parting inconvenience.

hint1: Runs fast, shoots far and chews gum.
hint2: Fires faster and further than almost anything else its size, but folds instantly to splash.
hint3: Sharp-eared and green, in a voodoo mask with red eyes, carrying a blowpipe.
description: A speedy ranged pest with constant pressure.

hint1: It also makes great brick-oven pancakes.
hint2: Sits still and periodically coughs out a small burning creature to run at whatever is nearest.
hint3: A squat metal oven that has sprouted stubby arms and feet.
description: A walking building that keeps producing trouble.

hint1: Spawns a pack of miniature Zap machines.
hint2: Three of them chain stuns onto a target, keeping it permanently interrupted while they whittle it down.
hint3: Three little wheeled machines topped with crackling coils.
description: Three small stunners that are annoying together.

hint1: Boom goes dynamite!
hint2: Throws explosives while alive, then detonates properly when he dies.
hint3: A stocky green fellow in a hard hat, arms full of dynamite.
description: A short fuse on legs.

hint1: A mischievous Spirit that leaps at enemies.
hint2: Leaps at the enemy and bursts, but the splash restores your own troops instead of hurting theirs.
hint3: A small lemon-yellow blob with a cheerful face.
description: A tiny helper that leaves a useful effect behind.

hint1: This invisible bush skulks towards the nearest building.
hint2: Creeps forward unseen until something spots it, then bursts open and lets out what is hiding inside.
hint3: A perfectly ordinary shrub. Nothing to see here.
description: A moving ‘nothing to see here’ that isn’t nothing.

hint1: Splits into two when destroyed.
hint2: Splits in two when destroyed, then splits again.
hint3: A wobbling mound of glowing purple goo.
description: A strange purple mass that refuses to stay in one piece.

hint1: Incinerates a small area, dealing high damage.
hint2: A single heavy impact on a modest area, with enough force to shove lighter troops backwards.
hint3: A blazing orb trailing smoke as it arcs down.
description: A direct answer to a crowded spot.

hint1: Deals high damage to a small area. Looks really awesome doing it.
hint2: Enormous damage in a very small circle, with a delay long enough that anything mobile walks out of it.
hint3: A finned iron shell with a nose cone and a skull painted on the side.
description: One expensive solution to one specific area.

hint1: Deals Damage per second to Troops and Crown Towers.
hint2: Rumbles on for several seconds after it lands, wearing down anything standing in the area - buildings included.
hint3: A murky brown vial that shatters and sets the tiles heaving.
description: A ground-based mess that punishes certain strategies.

hint1: Brawler always skips leg day.
hint2: Sits and waits; when it breaks open, the bruiser locked inside comes out swinging.
hint3: A barred iron box with something large and unhappy pacing inside.
description: A defensive box that turns into a new problem.

hint1: Don't look inside... you don't want to see how they're made.
hint2: Sits at the back and periodically pops out a small green thrower to harass the far tower.
hint3: A ramshackle wooden shack with a thatched roof and a crooked door.
description: A small factory that keeps adding annoying units.

hint1: Building that periodically spawns Skeletons to fight the enemy.
hint2: Trickles out bone soldiers while it stands, and coughs up four more the moment it breaks.
hint3: A cracked grey grave marker leaning in a patch of dirt.
description: A lonely structure with unsettling activity around it.

hint1: Deals area damage to anything dumb enough to stand near it.
hint2: Hurls explosives down from above, bursting over anything clustered beneath.
hint3: A bony figure perched atop a roped wooden frame, lobbing charges from on high.
description: A building that makes ground crowds regret grouping.

hint1: Burns through even the biggest and toughest enemies!
hint2: A beam that starts weak and ramps up the longer it stays on one target, melting even the biggest.
hint3: A glowing orange lens set atop a tall iron frame.
description: A building that gets more dangerous the longer it’s ignored.

hint1: Building that periodically spawns Troops to fight the enemy.
hint2: Periodically turns out a single axe-wielding brute to march down the lane.
hint3: A crude wooden shack with a sword hoisted above the entrance.
description: A hut that keeps releasing more visitors.

hint1: You gotta spend Elixir to make Elixir!
hint2: Produces nothing offensive at all - it just quietly pays for itself and then some.
hint3: A wooden rig with a tall glass vat bubbling between two slabs.
description: A building that tempts your opponent into doing something.

hint1: Three ruthless bone brothers with shields.
hint2: Three of them, each behind a shield that soaks one hit before they turn fragile.
hint3: Three bony figures in black helmets with coloured plumes, carrying spears and small shields.
description: A small group that’s tougher than it first looks.

hint1: Burps fireballs from the sky that deal area damage.
hint2: Breathes flame that splashes across a small area rather than striking one target.
hint3: A small spring-green hatchling with stubby wings and a permanent grin.
description: A flying splash attacker with steady value.

hint1: Meet Larry and his friends Harry, Terry, Gerry, Mary, etc.
hint2: Fifteen arrive at once and mob a single target - unstoppable without splash, erased by any.
hint3: A scattered crowd of small bone figures, all sword and no armour.
description: A sudden crowd that punishes slow answers.

hint1: Summons Skeletons, shoots destructo beams, has glowing pink eyes that unfortunately don't shoot lasers.
hint2: Fires splash bolts while continuously summoning small bone helpers to screen her.
hint3: A pale woman in a violet cloak with glowing pink eyes, floating rather than walking.
description: A ranged unit that keeps bringing extra company.

hint1: Swings from the hip, but packs a huge punch.
hint2: One devastating swing at a time, slow enough that swarms tear her apart before she connects twice.
hint3: A towering suit of dark blue-steel armour with a massive blade.
description: A slow wall of steel with one-job focus

hint1: It sounds like he has a bucket on his head.
hint2: Charges up to a heavy first strike, carries a shield that absorbs a hit, and splashes on contact.
hint3: A man in near-black plate with a horned helm and a spiked club.
description: A charging threat that’s hard to stop cleanly.

hint1: Don't let the little pony fool you.
hint2: Builds up a charge and lands a doubled first blow, then settles into ordinary swings.
hint3: A man in gleaming golden armour on a small horse, carrying a striped lance.
description: A heavy hitter that becomes scary when it gets momentum.

hint1: As pretty as they are, you won't want a parade of THESE.
hint2: Drifts overhead dropping heavy explosives, and leaves one more behind when it goes down.
hint3: A patched cloth sack trailing ropes, with a small pilot in the basket beneath.
description: A slow flying threat that you must respect.

hint1: The bigger the skeleton, the bigger the bomb.
hint2: Carries a payload that detonates enormously where he dies, which is often more dangerous than he is.
hint3: A colossal frame of bone in a furred cap, with a pronounced underbite.
description: A big tank that leaves a final ‘goodbye.’

hint1: Need your weapons sharpened? You've come to the right place.
hint2: Empowers friendly troops around her as she advances, making them considerably more dangerous.
hint3: A hulking woman with long orange hair hiding her eyes.
description: A supportive tank that makes nearby allies feel stronger.

hint1: This jolly green Goblin Giant stomps towards enemy buildings.
hint2: Carries a pair of small throwers on his back who keep attacking over his shoulders.
hint3: A colossal aquamarine brute in a brown aviator cap.
description: A big attacker who arrives with backup.

hint1: What he lacks in accuracy, he makes up for with his impressively bushy eyebrows.
hint2: Fires a spread of pellets that all land at once - devastating point-blank, nearly harmless at range.
hint3: Bushy moustache, fur cap, and a sawn-off he clearly maintains himself.
description: A ranged fighter whose best work happens up close.

hint1: Slow but durable, only attacks buildings.
hint2: Explodes when destroyed and leaves two smaller versions that carry on, each exploding in turn.
hint3: A lumbering brute of dark rock with glowing eyes and crystals across its back.
description: A massive commitment that doesn’t end when it ‘ends.

hint1: Suffers from middle child syndrome to boot.
hint2: Each shot forks to three targets in a line, briefly interrupting all of them.
hint3: A stout blue flier with grey spots along its back and crackling jaws.
description: A flying attacker that spreads pressure across targets.

hint1: A daring duo of dangerous dive bombers.
hint2: Two of them sprint past all defenders and detonate on arrival, achieving nothing at all if intercepted first.
hint3: Two bony runners in coloured bandanas, each shouldering a lit charge.
description: A fast gamble that aims for high impact.

hint1: Don't tell him that his finger guns aren't real!
hint2: Anything that hits him gets shocked in return, punishing melee defenders for engaging.
hint3: A bare-chested colossus with a spiked beard and a humming pack strapped to his back.
description: A huge threat that punishes you for hitting it wrong.

hint1: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks.
hint2: Rolls a boulder that keeps going in a straight line, striking everything behind the first target too.
hint3: A relaxed indigo-skinned ogre with blue eyes and heavy shoulders.
description: A slow tanky unit that controls space in a straight line.

hint1: It's a miracle he doesn't lose an arm.
hint2: Throws an axe that damages everything on the way out and again on the way back.
hint3: A shirtless man with a large red nose and a permanent five-o'clock shadow.
description: A durable ranged unit that hits more than once.

hint1: Bet they won't see that coming!
hint2: Rolls forward behind a shield; when that breaks it plants itself and keeps firing from where it stands.
hint3: A wheeled wooden wagon with an iron tube mounted on top.
description: A mobile threat that changes behavior when pressured.

hint1: It's going to be a thrilling ride, boys!
hint2: Thrown anywhere on the map, cracking open to spill three small green attackers on landing.
hint3: A wooden keg tumbling through the air, painted with a grinning green face.
description: An object that lands where you don’t want it.

hint1: Bolts of lightning damage and stun up to three enemy troops or buildings.
hint2: Strikes the three highest-health targets in the area and briefly stuns each of them.
hint3: A deep blue liquid in a heavy vial.
description: A sharp answer from above.

hint1: Everybody chill.
hint2: Stops everything caught in the area dead for a few seconds, dealing almost no damage.
hint3: A cyan liquid bottled in a transparent jar.
description: A spell that creates a short, unfair moment.

hint1: It rolls over and damages anything in its path.
hint2: Rolls along the ground damaging everything in its path, then breaks open and lets out a fighter.
hint3: A spiked wooden keg tumbling end over end.
description: A rolling clear that leaves something behind.

hint1: Covers the area in a deadly toxin.
hint2: Lingers over an area for several seconds, steadily wearing down anything that stays in it.
hint3: A deep red liquid in a thin oblong vial.
description: A lingering area that makes standing still a bad plan.

hint1: And thrice were their afflictions... nixed, vexed, and hexed!
hint2: Deals little damage itself, but makes everything in the area take more from everything else.
hint3: A lime-green liquid in a vial capped with a wooden face - three golden hairs, two green eyes.
description: A spell that changes how losses feel.

hint1: Increases troop movement and attack speed.
hint2: Makes friendly troops in the area move and strike noticeably faster for a short while.
hint3: A deep purple potion in a large bottle.
description: A simple ‘go faster’ moment.

hint1: Troops are fragile, but pack the same punch as the original!
hint2: Duplicates your own troops in the area - the copies hit just as hard but die to a stiff breeze.
hint3: A translucent teal liquid in a small oblong vial.
description: “A risky trick that can snowball or flop.

hint1: Drags enemy troops to its center while dealing damage over time, just like a magnet.
hint2: Drags every enemy in a wide radius into one spot while chipping away at them.
hint3: A swirling grey funnel that hauls everything toward its middle.
description: spell that ruins positioning.

hint1: Does not appear in your starting hand.
hint2: Plays whatever you played last all over again, for one more than it cost the first time.
hint3: A reflective silver surface in an ornate frame.
description: A flexible card that depends on what you just did.

hint1: You shall not pass! Unless there are lot of you...
hint2: Pulses three times over a few seconds, hurting a single strong target far more than a crowd.
hint3: A deep orange-amber liquid in a large vial.
description: A dark zone that’s stronger in the right situation.

hint1: Nice tower you got there. Would be a shame if this whittled it down from this side of the Arena...
hint2: Plants itself and fires a rapid stream of bolts clear across the arena at the enemy tower.
hint3: A siege weapon of wood, stone and steel with a gleaming bolt loaded on top.
description: A device that locks in and refuses to blink.

hint1: Building capable of burrowing underground and appearing anywhere in the Arena.
hint2: Burrows underground and surfaces anywhere on the map, then keeps sending up small green fighters.
hint3: A wooden hull with a circular hatch and a spinning metal bit on top.
description: A structure that shows up uninvited.

hint1: He lands with the force of 1,000 mustaches, then jumps from one foe to the next.
hint2: Lands with a crushing blast on arrival, then leaps between targets doing the same again.
hint3: A hulking figure in heavy armour with a plumed helm and a mace on each fist.
description: A heavy entrance followed by heavy presence.

hint1: Together they charge through the Arena; snaring enemies, knocking down towers... and chewing grass?!
hint2: Builds into a charge against structures, while the woman on top flings a snare that badly slows anything nearby.
hint3: A shaggy horned beast at full tilt, with a set of bolas whirling overhead.
description: A fast duo that disrupts movement and plans.

hint1: He lands with a "POW!", stuns nearby enemies and shoots lightning with both hands!
hint2: Arrives with a stun, then fires from both hands at once, interrupting two targets continuously.
hint3: A sharp-eared man with black spiked hair, a matching moustache, and crackling gloves.
description: A flashy arrival that interrupts fights.

hint1: Shoots a focused beam of fire that increases in damage over time. Wears a helmet because flying can be dangerous.
hint2: A focused beam that grows hotter the longer it holds one target, but resets the moment it is interrupted.
hint3: A small flier in an aviator helmet with a fuel tank strapped on and a yellow hose.
description: A flyer that becomes scarier the longer it’s ignored.

hint1: Overkill isn't in her vocabulary.
hint2: Takes several seconds to wind up, then unleashes one enormous blast - and any stun resets the whole charge.
hint3: A golden coil on wheels with a steel ram bolted to the front.
description: Slow buildup, huge payoff.

hint1: It's not magic, it's a shovel.
hint2: Tunnels underground and surfaces anywhere you like, including right on top of a tower.
hint3: A man in a dark grey helmet with a half-melted candle stuck on top.
description: A sneaky unit that shows up where you don’t want it.

hint1: If you're feeling warm feelings towards her, it's probably because you're on fire.
hint2: Strikes from further away than anything else in the game, setting a small area alight.
hint3: A woman with dark brown hair in a crown, carrying a longbow.
description: A long-range nuisance that forces awkward answers.

hint1: This mystical creature will be reborn as an egg when destroyed.
hint2: Comes back once - when killed it leaves an egg that hatches into a smaller version of itself.
hint3: A light red bird with teal eyes and a maroon beak, trailing embers.
description: A flying threat that refuses to be a one-time deal.

hint1: He drifts invisibly through the Arena until he's startled by an enemy.
hint2: Drifts along unseen and untouchable, only becoming solid in the moment he swings.
hint3: A translucent undead king in a crown, chain mail and dark gauntlets.
description: A roaming threat that appears and disappears.

hint1: He has a handlebar mustache that's too hot for TV.
hint2: Every shot chills what it touches, slowing attacks and movement rather than killing outright.
hint3: Frost-white spiked hair, a heavy blue cloak, and a moustache with its own gravity.
description: A control unit that makes everything feel slower.

hint1: Not quite a Wizard, nor an Archer.
hint2: Looses a single shot that travels right through everything in its path, hitting a whole line at once.
hint3: A white-haired man with glowing turquoise eyes and a slender bow.
description: A ranged unit that punishes bad lines.

hint1: The mask keeps her identity safe.
hint2: Dashes at anything far enough away, and cannot be touched at all mid-dash.
hint3: A green-eyed woman in a mask and dark olive cloak, white hair tied back.
description: A quick figure that never stays still.

hint1: A majestic flying beast that attacks buildings.
hint2: Soaks damage on the way in, then bursts into a swarm of small angry fliers when destroyed.
hint3: A floating mass of molten rock with an underbite and glowing cracks.
description: A giant flying commitment that brings extra baggage.

hint1: Summons Bats to do her bidding!
hint2: Continuously sends out small winged creatures while she fights, and releases a final batch on death.
hint3: A blue-eyed woman in a black cloak carrying a heavy staff.
description: A support threat that keeps adding pressure over time.

hint1: He chops trees by day and hunts The Log by night.
hint2: Swings faster than almost anything alive, and drops a lingering boost on his allies when he falls.
hint3: A burly man with an axe and a bottle strapped to his shoulder.
description: A fast hitter that leaves a messy aftermath

hint1: Rider of Dragons.
hint2: Can be played small and cheap or large and expensive, with the fliers she brings scaling to match.
hint3: A warrior with a glowing blue scimitar, flanked by winged creatures.
description: A flexible threat with two moods.

hint1: Who let a baby drive this thing?
hint2: A walking mech that fires a heavy rocket volley once it has built up enough charge.
hint3: A wood-and-metal walker with green zigzag markings and spikes along its edges.
description: A bulky contraption built by goblins.

hint1: She also bakes great cookies.
hint2: Curses whatever she hits, so anything that dies afterwards turns into a pig fighting for you.
hint3: A blue-eyed woman in a purple cloak lined with pink.
description: A witch who benefits from chaos.

hint1: He's also mastered the ancient art of 'Fish Slapping'.
hint2: Hurls a hook that yanks a target across the arena to him, then slaps it about at close range.
hint3: A broad man with a big nose and blond beard, coiled rope at his belt.
description: A disruptor that changes where fights happen.

hint1: Now, it seeks revenge by crushing anything in its path!
hint2: Rolls the length of the lane, crushing and shoving back everything on the ground as it goes.
hint3: A long spiked length of timber, rolling end over end.
description: A simple rolling answer that never stops being useful.

hint1: Surprise! It's a party. A Skeleton party, anywhere in the Arena. Yay!
hint2: Summons a steady stream of bone soldiers anywhere on the map for several seconds.
hint3: A creeping patch of cursed earth with hands clawing out of it.
description: A spell that turns any moment into a problem.

hint1: A warrior with luxurious hair and outstanding flexibility.
hint2: His ability sends him dashing from one enemy to the next, chaining up to ten times in a row.
hint3: A blue-eyed man with flowing blond hair and a light blade.
description: A flashy fighter with sudden bursts of movement.

hint1: The King of the undead himself.
hint2: Collects souls from everything that dies nearby, then spends them to raise a whole army at once.
hint3: A towering figure of bone in a dark chestplate and heavy gauntlets, wearing a crown.
description: A tanky leader who benefits from nearby destruction.

hint1: The boss of the Forest Gang finally shows her face...kind of.
hint2: Her ability blinks her six tiles backwards under cover of smoke, leaving pursuers swinging at nothing.
hint3: A teal-eyed woman with light red hair, masked and cloaked.
description: A fast boss who doesn’t like being pinned down.

hint1: She is fast, deadly and hard to catch.
hint2: Her ability turns her invisible for a few seconds while she keeps firing.
hint3: A crowned woman with a heavy crossbow and a long cape.
description: A high-threat ranged unit that demands an answer.

hint1: This makes him not only the mightiest, but also the sneakiest Miner in the Arena.
hint2: Grinds down whatever he touches with damage that ramps up, and his ability tunnels him to the other lane.
hint3: A hunk with tangerine hair and a matching moustache, carrying a heavy drill.
description: A steady bruiser who can suddenly change the situation.

hint1: It’s ALIVE! Monster lumbers towards enemy buildings while Doctor waits to spring the trap
hint2: Arrives as two separate units, and the ability links them with a bolt that stuns whatever is caught between.
hint3: A hulking green brute with a square, flat-topped head, and the small doctor who built him.
description: A two-part menace that escalates fights quickly

hint1: Who let their nephew into the Arena?!
hint2: His ability calls in his guardian, who lands hard and fights alongside him.
hint3: A small crowned boy with a spear, and a scarred woman in grey armour with a greatsword.
description: A fragile-looking unit that becomes dangerous if ignored.

hint1: If the troop is in the air, they'll ground them. Don't worry, they'll grow on you!
hint2: Roots the strongest enemies in place, and hits harder the fewer of them there are.
hint3: Green tendrils bursting from the ground to wrap around whatever they catch.
description: A control spell that makes big threats behave.

hint1: Has spent many isolated years perfecting a new style of combat.
hint2: His ability has him deflect incoming attacks back the way they came for a few seconds.
hint3: A tan man with a white mohawk and beard, fighting with open hands.
description: A calm brawler that shuts down the wrong attacks.
